label: Daily Ops Digest
info: Fires at 7:30 AM ET — pulls scraper health, arrest counts, active bonds, and FTA alerts from the FastAPI backend, formats a rich Slack digest, and posts to #ops-daily.

label: Scraper Health Webhook
info: Every 15 min: polls /api/scraper-health, detects scrapers that just went into error state (wasn't error on last poll), and posts a Slack alert to #scraper-alerts. Maintains a global error-state cache to avoid duplicate alerts.

name: Build Health Request
Diff & Alert New Errors

label: FTA Alert Relay
info: Polls /api/arrests/stats/multi-state every 30 min. If any active bond defendant appears in new arrest records (re-arrest), fires a Slack alert to #fta-alerts with defendant name, county, charge, and bond amount.

name: Build FTA Request
Log Result
